docx_content:
Topic: Pathen intheng gelkhoh masat pendia kouna awgin 
Text: Haggai 1:1-15  & Ezra 1-4         Key verse: Haggai:1:4 
520 BC vel chun Israelte Kum 70 jen Babylon a asoh channa uva konin Persia lengpa Cyrus thusah in agamsungu ahung kile tauvin ahi (Ezra 1). Hiche pet a amahon agelkhoh masat pen uchu Pathen Houin sahphat ding chu ana hi. Hiti chun gunchutah le thanom tah in Houin sah ana pan uvin ahile jetle vei sah le lhanga kona doudalna (melma, thasetna le lunglhahdaina) jat chom2 ho jeh chun Houin sah chu ana hai tauvin ahi (Ezra 4). Pathen Houn sah sangin amaho inn chen le natoh ding loubol ding joh ana khohsah jo tauvin Pathen Houin chu abulpi (foundation) bou akijamin don louvin ana koi tauvin ahi (Ezra 3). Hiche phat laiya hi Houin sah banjop kit na ding thusei dinga Haggai themgao hi Pathenin ana sol ahi. Tun hiche thilsoh hi kum 2000 masang peh hita jongle eiho dinmun toh akikhel na behseh aumpon phatvet banga kivetna thei hidingin tahsan aumin hiche ho chu anoiyah hin ana veu hite. 
Athupipen gelkhohna dia kouna (verse 4)
“Vo kamite idia nangho in phatah tah a chenga, kei Houin asesa kijam ham?”

Ibol a Pathenin hiche thucheng a hi amite ana phosal ham atile Israel te chun chenna thei mei2 in akisah pouvin in nom tah2 (luxurious house) akisah uva Pathen Houin asesa kijam chu sahphat ding agel khoh lou jeh uva ana phosal u ahi. Pathenin Haggai themgao kamma asei doh nom hi Houin jong chu hinante amavang amite lungchang Pathen ngaisahna alhahsamnau chu aseidoh nom hinte ti ginchat aume. Ajeh chu alungthim uva Pathen gelkhohna nei uvin lang hile Houin hi asesa akijam sah louhel diu ahi ti mudoh thei ahi. 
Application: Tunia eiho TCC Houin jong Jerusalem Houin kisei banga foundation kipan doh ahitan sum le pai lhahsam jeh in aban akichal but tapon ahi. Tunin Pathenin Haggai themgao kamchenga asei banga eiho jong in nom tah2 a ichen uva loulho thingpoh chule eima in chen bou ikikhohsah a Pathen houin hitia hi akhom bou kitungdoh khu imoh vet diu hitam? Tunikho in jong pathenin chunga Israelte thudoh adoh khu eiho jong eidong cheh uve tin gel utin inopsah na luggel pailhan Houin sah phatna dingin pan la uhite tin iki tem uve.

Ichung uva thilsohho kikhol/vepha kit dia kouna (verse 5-7)
“Nachung uva thilsoh mulou nahiuvem?”……..

Israel te chu kichol louhel in akisa boiyun amavang Pathen Houin donlouva akoi jeh un atoh gao chungah lung lhaina le kipana anei thei pouve. Muchi tampi2 atu vangun lhosohga themcha bou amu uvin, neh ding anei vangun oivana khamin anei pouve, lengpitwi don ding aneiyun chimnan anei pouve na atong2 jengun hinlah oivanan anei pouve. Chu tobanga agenthei nau jouse hi  thildang jeh ahipon Pathenin akounau ahibouve. 


Application: Pathen kouna ingai lou teng ule ipi bol jong leu hen kipana le lungna chimna inei lou diu ahi ti Israelte umchan a kon mudoh thei ahi. Sum le pai tam pitah kinei hen Jeep le car hoi tah2 tampitah kinei jongle Pathen apan lou tengle kana le lhiso na ding bep ahi. Hijeh chun tunia ipi hi iha boipi pen em? ahiloule ikhohsah pen em? ikhohsah igel khoh lah a chu Pathen Houin sahphat ding hi jao hinam ti kikhol cheh din ikitem uve achuti loule Pathenin Verse 9 a “Kamut mangpeh jitai” ati banga ahomkeo seh imu diu ahi. 

Ibol thei ipan theina cheh a pang dia kouna (verse 8-15)
“Tun thinglhang lama kaltouvun, ithil gajongun Houin saphauvin;……

Pathenin in kicheh selin thinglhang lama kal touva inthil gajong dingin amite chu tepna aneiyin hibang chun Pakai sole Haggai thusei chu anagaiyun Zerubbbabel le Joshua chule mipin Pakai a-Pathen un boldia aseipeh u chu aboltauve. Hijeh chun Pathen achung uva alung lhai tan “Kaum pi jing ding nahiuve ati”(verse13)
Application: Pathenin Israel te thinglhang lama kaltouva inthil jong dia aseipeh bangin tunin nangle kei jong ipau Pathenin alen aneo ateh akhang eikou cheh uve, achutile nang le na insungmite tunia Houin saphat kitna dinga ipia napan tah em? Pathenin itouna muna kona kipandoh ta dingin eitem cheh uve. Ibola “thinglhang” kiti thucheng hi aman chah ham itile Pathen natoh hi thilbai ahipoi ti avetsah hidingin ginchat aume. Amavang ilungneo lou na diu chu verse 13 a Israelte henga “kaumpi jing ding na hiuve” tia sei Pathen khu eiho Pathen jong ahin ikipat doh phot2 ule aman eilhon pi jing diu ahi ti sumil pou hite. 
 Thukhumkhana (conclusion)
Houin sahphat kiti hi cement, concrete, chule neldi ho keoseh ahipon eiho dinga Pathen lenggam na itohna thei diu lampi/kot lentah Pathenin eihon peh u ahi. Tunin Pathenin khat cheh hi thudoh einei cheh uve tin gel leuhen vetsahnan Nagel khoh pen chu keima Houin sahphat ding hinam? Ole nangma housatna ding in nomtah a chenna ding bou nagelkhoh nalai em? Tunia nakisah boi naho chun kipana le lung lhaina napeh hinam? A houin sahna dia ipia pan nalah hitam? Ahiloule ipia pan la dia nakigel tam? Hijeh chun achaina keiyin Haggai khanglai mite banga kithoudoh a Pathen koma “Pakai keima kichoi atna ding hilouvin nangma loupina dingin na Houin sahphat na dingin pan la tange” tia kipan doh thei ta dingin Pathenin athu ibon chao chung phatthei boh tahen.  Amen

foundation.title: Building Our Foundation, <br className="hidden md:block"/> Generation to Generation.
paragraphs: Achesa Pakai kum 1989 kum a amasa pen a dinga Tengnoupal Christian Church houin foundation stone ana kitung doh a dam leh bit kei a akisah doh nunga 30th December, 1997 a ana kilut nunga anichan na ading a houin sah nadingin, tukum 2023 in vel ni channa dingin houin sah pat pat ding thei a ium tah jeh un Chung Pathen thangvah na ipe uve.
Achesa 22nd January, 2023 nikho in anuiya amin hung kitah lang chengsi hi Church Building Committee ding in lhendoh ahi tauvin chuleh lhandoh na kin jong ana kinei tan ahi.

houbong.title: Tengnoupal Houbung
history: KCC(M) TENGNOUPAL GAΜΚΑΙ HUNG KISEM DOL CHULEH KIVAI HOMNA

1. LHANG GAMKAI: Kuki Christian Church, Manipur Synod gamkai'a ahung kihop phat in Tengnoupal houbung hi Lhang Gamkai sungin anahop in, Pr. Ch. Doukholun Mate gamkai Secretary vaihomna noija Tengnoupal gambih ti in Sugnu Gambih le Churachandpur Gambih toh ana kiumkhom in ahi. 1988 kum in Lhang Gamkai Khoppi masapen G. Songgel Christian Church mun'ah ana kimangin ahi. 1989 kum in ani channa Gamkai Khoppi Tengnoupal Christian Church mun'ah kiman kit in ahi. Chuleh 1990 kum in athum channa Gamkai Khoppi Churandchandpur Songpi Christian Church mun'ah ana kimangin ahi.

2. TENGNOUPAL GAMΚΑΙ: 1997 - 1998 kum sung'ah Lhang-gam KCC (M) Tengnoupal Gamkai le Churachandpur Gamkai a ahung kihop khen phat in Tengnoupal Gamkai hi Pr. Ch. Doukholun Mate Secretary hina noija Tengnoupal gambih, Moreh gambih, Laijang gambih chuleh Dingpi gambih hotoh Pathen na ana kitong khom in ahi. 2000 kum December Iha in Moreh Town Church a Tengnoupal gamkai khoppi masa ana kimangin, 2002 kum in Yangngoubung Christian Church, 2003 kum in Canaan Veng Christian Church a Gamkai khoppi anakibol in ahi.

19th October 1999 nin gamkai sunga Pastor hole Executive Member ho thukin'a kihouna anaum in ahileh hichea chun Gamkai Choir ana kisemdoh in chuleh Choir Form jong ana kisempeh in ahi. Hiche kum Nisim 28th November in Tengnoupal Gamkai Kuki Christian Church kikhopna masapen Tengnoupal Christian Church a anaum in hichea ana kilolna ho chu ahileh:
(1) Laijang gambih le Dingpi gambih te ni ana kisem toh'e.
(2) Gamkai Centre Tengnoupal hiding chuleh gamkai in Office Assistant neiding tin Pu. Tongkhosei Mate ana kilhengdoh in ahi.
(3) Pastor Jangkholun Guite gamkai Choir Director in ana kilhengdoh in ahi. Chuleh Upa Seikholet Baite (Tengnoupal) in gamkai choir ho manchah din Register Book khat anatoh in ahi.

Hitichun Tengnoupal gamkai Secretary Pr. Ch. Doukholun Mate in anapoh jouvin Pr. Hemlet Singson in kum phabep anapon, tuhin Pr. Ch. Doukholun Mate in ahinpo kit in gamkai sung lungmon naleh khantouna'a ama chal jingin ahi.
gms: 1988 July lha nisim 10 Pathen nikhon Lahe (Burma) gam'a missionary project natol patna dingin Nikho ana kimang in ahi. Hiche nikho man'a a hin 'Khodah uvin loujao hokho veuvin' (John. 4:35) ti hí Thupi in ana kimang in chuleh thuseiyin Rev. Ch. Doukholun Mate (Secretary Lhang Gamkai) apangin hichea chun Lahe gam missionary Pr. Shonjang in anatoh na gam umdol le anatoh dol thulhut aneiyin ahi. Hiche hi houbung in atumbeh a missionary kigoina masapen ahi. Hiche nikho hin Christian Church of Burma Board member ho jong thanom tah in ahung pang'uve. Thupi seipan aseichai na ding nilhah in missionary challenge abol in ahileh mipiho lah a konin kum'a peding loi, lha a peding loi, thilkeo peloi, gancha peloi achung chon in mipi thil pedin akitol tul tul jengin ahileh ivet leh Pathen Lhagao natohna kidang tah in akilangdoh in ahi.

2001 kum in Pu. Thongkholun Mate le Pu.Ngulkhohou Mate Tolsung Houbung hetpehnan GMS natohna Tripura mission field a anache lhonin ahi. 2002 kum'a kipat in haseh a Pathen ni nunung pen GMS (Gamthim Mission Society) kaikhom in tuni chan geiyin ahung kimang peh tan ahi. Chuleh Tripura Mission Jilkung'a synod in asolho thalo akipe pan in hichea chun Pu. HI. Thangjang Mate in Pathen natohna in Rs.3000/-mi-1 lha- khat-lo anatohdoh in amahi GMS natohna a lhalo toh masapen ahung hitan ahi. Hiche gamthim natohna a hin tuni chan in Houbung in mi-ni lhalo akipe jingin ahi.

kck.title: Kuki Christian Khangthah (KCK)
history: 1982 kum in Pathen in houbung sunga Khangthah te ahin mangchan Pathen vahchoina lasah le Pathen thu lam'ah machalna ahung umdoh kittan ahileh vahchoina la toh thoding tumging thei Electric Guiter-2 (ni) chuleh Harmonium-1 (khat) akichodoh tan ahi. 1983 kum in KCK(A) Khoppi akilan ahi. 1999 kum in KCK ten music instrument Keyboard khat ana lamdoh'un ahi. 2000 kum in houbung in ananei khah lou hou-in'a manchah din Battery khat Pu. Jamkhoshon Mate (EE-Electricity) in KCK te anachoh peh in chuleh KCK te Music Project tohgon noiya Pu. L. Doukhosei Mate (IRS) in Amply 1500 Watts khat ana choh peh'un ahi.

1998 kum in Pr. Ch. Doukholun Mate le Pr. Jangshon Touthang lamkai nan gamkai sunga Dingpi le Laijang gambih a preaching ana cheuvin ahi. Khengjang Synod KCK khoppi'ah tolsung KCK ten jong pan analauvin ahi. 1996 kum in KCK ten Khongkhang Chothe Baptist Church Golden Jubilee chuleh 2004 kum in Saivom BYF te Golden Jubilee a Choir-seat analo uvin ahi. 2008 kum in Molding houbung'a um Manipur Synod KCK Gospel Olympic a pan anala uvin ahi. 2013 kum in 'Mobile Phone Mandan Aphatna le Asema Essay Writing Competition anabol'un ahi. Hiche kum 'a kipat in KCK ten An-ngol taona jong ahinbol pan uvin ahi.

kcn.title: Kuki Christian Numeite (KCN)
history: Nute hohi houbung sunga Pathen lenggam natohna a pan anala jing ahiuvin, Atohdoh'u tampi umjongle alhangpi a themkhat bou ahung kitah langin ahi.
1. 5th August 2005 ni akipat in Nute mopohna in An Ngol Taona tuni geiyin abol jing'un ahi.
2. 2005 kum in nuten insung tao-gol ananei'un ahi.
3. 2008 kum in Tolsunga Nuten Pate Revival Camp anabol peh'un ahi.
4. 2010 kum in houbunga mandin chakhon 100 tobang ana chodoh'un ahi. Hiche kum a hin Seminar khat anabol'un ahi.

kcu.title: Kuki Christian Upalom (KCU)
history: 1986 kum in Manipur Synod in ahingon dungjui in Tengnoupal houbung' ah jong KCU Lom anaum panin Chairman in Pu. Ch. Jamkhokhai Mate chuleh Secretary in Pu. M. Tongkhokhai Haokip ana pang lhon e, amani hi Tengnoupal houbung a KCU lamkai masapen ana hi lhon in ahi.
Hiche a kipat KCU lom in in Pathen lenggam natohna a pan ahin lauvin society a din Farm lei khat anabol'un ahi.
2007 kum in Pate Seminar anabol'un Thusei in Pr. Jamkhongam Haokip anapang in ahi.
2008 kum in pate khohsahna jalin tolsung KCN ten Pate Revival Camp anabol peh'un hichea chun Pr. Houthang Lhungdim le Evan. Jangkhokai Haokip ana kikou in ahi.
Chuleh 2011 kum in Evan. Tongkhojang Lhouvum ana kikou in Pate Seminar ana kibol in ahi.
